threat_event: Attackers enter through the Resort 2 POS vendor's remote tool, install memory-scraping malware on the legacy POS, and move to CRO PCs to capture keyed card numbers (POS and reservation system compromise)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Resort 2 POS is not P2PE and runs an unsupported operating system; vendor remote tool with no MFA; Active Directory traffic allowed from the POS VLAN to the corporate network; CRO agents key card numbers on general-purpose PCs
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 (Resort 2); SYS-07 CRO PCs; SYS-06; BP-03; BP-05; BP-06
existing_controls: EDR on CRO PCs with 24x7 MSSP; P2PE at resort front desks and Resort 1 outlets; quarterly ASV scans
treatment_plan: Move both vendors to the privileged access broker with MFA and per-session approval; block Active Directory traffic from the POS VLAN; allowlisting on POS workstations and CRO PCs; replace Resort 2 POS with a validated P2PE cloud POS; keypad entry devices for CRO phone payments
exposure_estimate_usd: $1.5M-$4M (card brand assessments, PFI investigation, reissue costs, notification; up to about 400,000 cards a year pass through Resort 2 outlets and the CRO)

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts resort servers, corporate systems, and cloud workloads, stops PMS interfaces and lock servers, and steals guest data for extortion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Domain administrator accounts outside the broker; lock servers and Resort 2 POS outside the SIEM; untested restores for lock servers, data warehouse, and CRM
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06; SYS-07; SYS-08; SYS-10; BP-01; BP-02; BP-10
existing_controls: MFA for all users; EDR with MSSP; immutable backups in a separate account
treatment_plan: Bring domain administrators into the broker; send lock server and POS logs to the SIEM; quarterly restore tests; lock server cloud backups; ransomware runbook (P08)
exposure_estimate_usd: $1.5M-$3.5M (72-hour outage about $620,000 per P05, response, notification; insurance limit $10M)

threat_event: Spoken card numbers and security codes in CRO call recordings are taken by an insider or an attacker with access to the recording store
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 31,000 recordings hold card data; 13-month retention; 14 users can play recordings
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-15; SYS-10 call recording store; BP-05
existing_controls: Encryption at rest; playback limited to 14 users
treatment_plan: Pause-and-resume recording; purge recordings with card data; 90-day retention; keypad entry for CRO payments
exposure_estimate_usd: $400K-$1.2M (card reissue and brand costs; prohibited storage of security codes)

threat_event: Card authorization forms in group sales, catering, and accounting mailboxes are stolen after an email account compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2,860 emails with card numbers (418 with security codes) back to 2022; printed forms in an unlocked binder at 1 resort sales office
treatment_plan: Purge stored forms; block inbound card numbers with data loss prevention rules; payment links for all group deposits; lock and retire paper

threat_event: The Resort 2 POS vendor's or lock vendor's remote tool credentials are stolen and used to reach the CDE or the lock server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on remote tools with shared vendor logins and no MFA
existing_controls: Firewall allows the tools only to named servers
treatment_plan: Disable standing access; named vendor accounts through the access broker with MFA, approval, and recording

threat_event: The franchisor's network vendor access or a brand-managed firewall is compromised and exposes the Hotels 3 to 6 networks and terminals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No responsibility matrix; no visibility of brand firewall rules; standing brand vendor access; flat staff networks behind the firewall
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06 (Hotels 3 to 6); SYS-03 brand terminals; SYS-02
existing_controls: Brand MFA on brand PMS; brand firewall standard
treatment_plan: Signed PCI DSS responsibility matrix; quarterly brand firewall rule attestation; company-managed VLANs behind the brand firewall for terminals and PCs

threat_event: A stolen front desk credential is used to display card numbers and export guest profiles from SYS-01
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA in place, but no review of card display and export reports
existing_controls: SSO with MFA for all SYS-01 users
treatment_plan: Daily automated review of card displays and exports through the SIEM

threat_event: A malicious script on a resort website page that embeds the booking engine's payment form skims card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23 scripts on payment pages with no inventory, authorization, or tamper detection
treatment_plan: Script inventory and authorization; change-and-tamper detection on payment pages; remove 6 unused marketing scripts
owner: Vice President of Sales and Marketing

threat_event: A domain administrator or local server administrator account outside the access broker is taken over and used to disable defenses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing domain admin accounts at the resorts; local administrator accounts on the POS and lock servers
existing_controls: MFA for identity provider administrators; EDR
treatment_plan: Broker for domain and server administrators; phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; tiered admin model

threat_event: Shared night-audit logins and stale brand PMS accounts are used for folio fraud or card display at Hotels 3 to 6
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 franchised hotels share a night-audit login; 6 of 25 sampled leavers still active in the brand PMS
treatment_plan: Named night-audit accounts; termination checklist with brand removal within 1 business day; monthly reconciliation

threat_event: An employee with the card display permission copies virtual card or guest card numbers for fraud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 46 of 162 SYS-01 users can display full card numbers; 8 need to
existing_controls: Background checks for front office managers and CRO agents
treatment_plan: Remove the permission from 38 users; reviews every 6 months; display reports reviewed

threat_event: A skimmer or tampered device is placed on a brand terminal at Hotels 3 to 6 or a Resort 2 reader
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No device list with serial numbers at Hotels 3 to 6; informal inspections at Resort 2 and Hotels 3 to 6
existing_controls: P2PE devices with weekly inspections at Resort 1
treatment_plan: Device lists with serial numbers; weekly logged inspections; staff training
owner: Resort Directors of Food and Beverage

threat_event: Malware on a front desk PC at a franchised hotel spreads across the flat staff network to terminals and back office PCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One flat staff network at each of Hotels 3 to 6; EDR on 40 of 90 PCs there
existing_controls: Brand firewall at the internet edge
treatment_plan: VLANs for terminals, PCs, and lock encoders; EDR on all 90 PCs

threat_event: A SYS-01 vendor outage lasts beyond the 2-hour check-in RTO, and the contract gives no recovery commitment
threat_source: SYS-01 vendor infrastructure failure or cyber incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor states RTO 4 hours and RPO 15 minutes in its SOC 2 report only
existing_controls: Printed lists every 4 hours; emergency key cards
treatment_plan: Recovery terms at renewal (2027-03); downtime drills twice a year at both resorts

threat_event: A resort lock server fails or is encrypted and cannot be restored within its 1-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Weekly local-disk backup only; restore never tested; Resort 2 server operating system unsupported
existing_controls: Emergency key cards; mechanical override keys
treatment_plan: Nightly encrypted backups to the cloud backup account; documented rebuild with the lock vendor; restore test each quarter; replace the Resort 2 server

threat_event: A franchisor platform outage stops check-in, payments, and distribution at Hotels 3 to 6
threat_source: Franchisor infrastructure failure or cyber incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Franchise agreements state no recovery objectives; the brand continuity plan has not been shared
treatment_plan: Request brand continuity summary; printed lists at night audit; downtime drill at each franchised hotel

threat_event: The data warehouse or CRM cannot be restored, or takes longer than its RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No restore test since go-live
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests starting 2026-11-10

threat_event: A hurricane floods or damages on-site IT at a resort or a franchised hotel and no IT recovery plan exists for Hotels 3 to 6
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Resort 1 server room on the ground floor; Hotels 3 to 6 hurricane plans omit IT
existing_controls: Resort hurricane plans with IT steps; cellular failover at resorts
treatment_plan: IT sections in all hurricane plans; relocate Resort 1 lock server and core switch above flood level; cellular hot spots for Hotels 3 to 6
owner: Director of Loss Prevention and Safety

threat_event: The Resort 2 legacy POS server fails and outlets cannot take cards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single unsupported server; no card fallback in outlets
treatment_plan: Loaner P2PE devices with a standalone procedure until the 2027 POS replacement
owner: Resort Directors of Food and Beverage

threat_event: One of 9 card or guest-data vendors without a current AOC or SOC 2 report has a breach that exposes company data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No annual compliance status check (12.8.4); 9 incident notice clauses missing
treatment_plan: Collect AOCs and SOC 2 reports; add notice clauses; annual Tier 1 reviews (P09)

threat_event: The channel manager is compromised and online travel agency virtual card numbers are stolen in transit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Channel manager AOC dated 2025-04 (expired for annual purposes)
treatment_plan: Obtain a current AOC or replace the vendor at renewal

threat_event: The chatbot vendor keeps transcripts with card numbers and guest contact details indefinitely and they are exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention or masking terms; 61 transcripts found with card numbers
treatment_plan: Masking in chat; purge; 90-day retention in the contract (P10)
owner: Vice President of Sales and Marketing

threat_event: The revenue-management vendor pools the company's non-public rate and occupancy data into a benchmark shared with competitors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract allows pooling; feature on by default
regulatory_driver: N72-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)); Sherman Act 15 U.S.C. 1 (litigation risk)
treatment_plan: Opt out of pooled benchmarking; written confirmation; counsel review (P10)

threat_event: A contracted worker supplied by a staffing company steals guest property data or card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staffing contracts require background checks but the company never verifies them
treatment_plan: Annual attestation and sample audit of staffing company checks

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a vendor payment or a group refund
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank detail changes verified by email reply only
existing_controls: Two approvers for payments; email filtering
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for bank changes; finance training

threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing bypasses push MFA and exposes mailboxes that hold card forms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA is phishable; card forms in mailboxes
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators and finance; token theft detection

threat_event: A known-exploited vulnerability in an internet-facing SD-WAN or VPN appliance is exploited before patching
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Monthly patch window; no emergency path for edge devices
treatment_plan: Edge device patches within 72 hours of a known-exploited listing

threat_event: Cloud storage or the CRM is exposed to the internet by misconfiguration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Web agency and integration developers can deploy to the workloads account
existing_controls: Guardrails block public storage; posture alerts
treatment_plan: Quarterly guardrail review; posture alerts to the MSSP

threat_event: Backups in the backup account are deleted or encrypted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: None material: separate account, write-once, separate credentials
treatment_plan: Within appetite because backups are isolated and write-once; reviewed every 6 months

threat_event: An attacker exploits the unsupported operating systems on the Resort 2 POS server or lock server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vendor patches; both servers on networks reachable by vendors
treatment_plan: Restrict both servers to required flows; replace the lock server (2027 Q1) and the POS (2027 Q2)

threat_event: After a breach, the FTC finds the company's security unreasonable, citing practices like those alleged in FTC v. Wyndham
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Several gaps match the Wyndham allegations (stored card data, default password, vendor access, weak segmentation at franchised hotels)
treatment_plan: Execute the P03 roadmap; quarterly progress to the audit committee

threat_event: The privacy notice says the company does not store card data and does not name the chatbot, call analytics, or pooled pricing vendors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notice last updated in 2023
treatment_plan: Rewrite the privacy notice to match practice

threat_event: The chatbot and CRO phone scripts quote nightly rates without the mandatory $40 resort fee
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Chatbot integration quotes base rate; CRO script mentions the fee at the end of the call
treatment_plan: Total price first in chatbot answers and CRO scripts; monthly checks
owner: Vice President of Sales and Marketing

threat_event: The revenue-management system raises rates sharply during a declared state of emergency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Automatic publishing with no emergency cap; 2025 back-test showed 41% increases at Resort 2
treatment_plan: Emergency mode with a freeze at the 30-day average; human approval for increases (P10)

threat_event: CRO calls are recorded and analyzed by AI without the consent of every party
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Greeting announces recording on the main line only; transfers and outbound calls have no announcement
treatment_plan: Announcement on every inbound, transferred, and outbound call; agent script (P10)

threat_event: The AI applicant screening tool screens out applicants by race, sex, or disability
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No adverse impact testing; no accommodation path
treatment_plan: Adverse impact test each quarter; human review of every rejection; accommodation path (P10)

threat_event: The CCTV facial recognition feature is turned on without review and creates biometric data questions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature available in the video management software
treatment_plan: Lock the setting; any change needs AI review (P10)
owner: Director of Loss Prevention and Safety

threat_event: Staff paste guest or card data into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No technical block on public AI sites until 2026-09
treatment_plan: Block unapproved AI sites; training

threat_event: The 2026 SAQ D cannot be signed with evidence by 2026-12-31, leading to acquirer non-compliance fees or a demand for a full QSA assessment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scope not documented; stored card data; logging and testing gaps
treatment_plan: Scope document; QSA scoping review; agree compensating or remediation status with the acquirer for open items

threat_event: A notice deadline is missed after a card compromise (acquirer 24 hours, Visa 3 days, franchisor 24 hours, Florida 30 days)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staff did not know the clocks; no decision log before P08
treatment_plan: Card compromise tabletop with counsel; decision log; contact cards at every front office

threat_event: A card compromise investigation cannot scope the exposure window because logs are missing or expired
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Resort 2 POS, lock servers, and Hotels 3 to 6 not logged; 30-day local retention
treatment_plan: Onboard missing sources; 12-month retention
exposure_estimate_usd: $300K-$1.5M (wider card exposure window assumed by brands)

threat_event: Indefinite retention of ID scans and guest profiles makes any breach larger
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 152,000 ID scans and all registers kept indefinitely
treatment_plan: Retention schedule; purge ID scans after check-out plus 30 days; registers kept 2 years plus a buffer

threat_event: Background-check reports are disposed of without shredding
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR keeps printed reports in files
treatment_plan: Electronic-only reports; shredding certificates

threat_event: A denial-of-service attack takes the resort websites offline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: None material: content delivery service with protection
treatment_plan: Booking engine is vendor-hosted; phone and online travel agencies continue
owner: Vice President of Sales and Marketing

threat_event: A laptop or tablet with cached guest data is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: None material: encrypted and managed
treatment_plan: Encrypted data is not personal information under 501.171 when keys are not compromised

threat_event: Someone enters a network closet at a franchised hotel and plants a device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Closets on keys with no log
treatment_plan: Badge readers or key logs; visitor logs

threat_event: The SOC 2 Type 2 report is not ready on the REIT agreement timeline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gaps in access reviews, recovery testing, logging, and vendor management
treatment_plan: Remediate through 2027 Q1; observation period from 2027-04-01

threat_event: The guest Wi-Fi vendor misconfigures its network and bridges guest traffic to a staff network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-managed network
treatment_plan: Separation confirmed in 2026-07 walkthroughs and the vendor letter; checked in the annual segmentation test

threat_event: An interface credential (POS to PMS, PMS to lock server) that was never rotated is reused by an attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 11 interface credentials unchanged since installation
treatment_plan: Rotate all interface credentials; vault them

threat_event: An attacker signs in to the Resort 2 lock server with the vendor's default administrator password and issues or cancels keys (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default administrator password unchanged; server reachable from the vendor's remote tool
treatment_plan: Password changed 2026-08-12; check all vendor-managed systems for defaults; hardening standard

threat_event: Finger templates from the time clocks are exposed in a payroll vendor breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Biometric data is personal information under Florida law
treatment_plan: Confirm template encryption and notice terms with the vendor

threat_event: A security incident at the REIT-managed hotels (from 2027) is not reported to the owner within the agreement's 48 hours or the third-party agent's 10 days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: New contract; not yet in the runbooks before P08
treatment_plan: Owner notice in P08; contact list; tabletop before 2027-01-01
